findings.title: Alias authority creep prevention
findings.body: resolved-execution-identity.schema.json forbids role=AUTHORITY on aliases, prohibits project_id and other authority-shaped fields inside alias blocks via additionalProperties:false; test_alias_never_becomes_authority enforces it.

findings.title: Block mutable routing under UNKNOWN identity
findings.body: When resolution_status is UNKNOWN, conditional logic forces mutable_routing_allowed:false; tests test_unknown_identity_cannot_allow_mutation and test_unknown_identity_requires_mutable_routing_allowed_false enforce the contract.

findings.title: Rejection of multi_project_singleton and arbitrary sharing classes
findings.body: fleet-catalog-v2.schema.json restricts sharing_class/target_class to HOST_SINGLETON, PROJECT_SCOPED, WORKTREE_SCOPED, RETIRED; legacy fields multi_project_singleton/scope/state_scope/port_policy rejected via additionalProperties:false; 19 test parameterizations prove rejection.

findings.title: Lease endpoint/ownership evidence boundary
findings.body: service-lease-v2.schema.json requires runtime_kind/runtime_id in owner_runtime_identity and enforces additionalProperties:false in endpoint, blocking authority-field injection (e.g. path_hash) to launder identity.

findings.title: Prohibit global config mutation in receipts
findings.body: runner-materialization-receipt.schema.json requires shared_global_config_mutated=false and authority=PROVENANCE_ONLY; tests test_receipt_rejects_global_mutation and test_receipt_authority_must_be_provenance_only enforce it.

findings.title: ConPort TARGET_CLASS correctly assigned (no Wave 2 leakage)
